title: Coin, Vending, and Amusement Machine Servicers and Repairers
description: Install, service, adjust, or repair coin, vending, or amusement machines including video games, juke boxes, pinball machines, or slot machines.

tasks.text: Fill machines with products, ingredients, money, and other supplies.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical maintenance of machinery

dwas.name: Maintain work equipment or machinery.

tasks.text: Inspect machines and meters to determine causes of malfunctions and fix minor problems such as jammed bills or stuck products.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Locating wear and damage requires physical inspection

dwas.name: Inspect mechanical equipment to locate damage, defects, or wear.

tasks.text: Test machines to determine proper functioning.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on mechanical testing in physical environment

dwas.name: Test mechanical equipment to ensure proper functioning.

tasks.text: Replace malfunctioning parts, such as worn magnetic heads on automatic teller machine (ATM) card readers.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual replacement of mechanical parts

dwas.name: Replace worn, damaged, or defective mechanical parts.

tasks.text: Maintain records of machine maintenance and repair.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Log maintenance and repair records from data

dwas.name: Maintain repair or maintenance records.

tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical lubrication task requiring hands and access

dwas.name: Clean equipment, parts, or tools to repair or maintain them in good working order.
Lubricate equipment to allow proper functioning.

tasks.text: Order parts needed for machine repairs.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Ordering via systems automatable; human approves spend

dwas.name: Order materials, supplies, or equipment.

tasks.text: Adjust and repair coin, vending, or amusement machines and meters and replace defective mechanical and electrical parts, using hand tools, soldering irons, and diagrams.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on equipment adjustment for performance

dwas.name: Adjust equipment to ensure optimal performance.
Repair worn, damaged, or defective mechanical parts.

tasks.text: Record transaction information on forms or logs, and notify designated personnel of discrepancies.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Document routine operational activities from inputs

dwas.name: Document operational activities.

tasks.text: Keep records of merchandise distributed and money collected.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Document routine operational activities from inputs

dwas.name: Document operational activities.

tasks.text: Collect coins and bills from machines, prepare invoices, and settle accounts with concessionaires.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — In-person payment handling; some digital automation

dwas.name: Collect payments for goods or services.

tasks.text: Make service calls to maintain and repair machines.
tasks.rationale: situated mobility — Physical travel to sites requires human mobility

dwas.name: Travel to work sites to perform installation, repair or maintenance work.
dwas.gwa_name: Operating Vehicles, Mechanized Devices, or Equipment

tasks.text: Adjust machine pressure gauges and thermostats.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on equipment adjustment for performance

dwas.name: Adjust equipment to ensure optimal performance.

tasks.text: Disassemble and assemble machines, according to specifications and using hand and power tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Dismantling heavy machinery is physical trade work

dwas.name: Assemble mechanical components or machine parts.
Dismantle heavy equipment or machinery.

tasks.text: Contact other repair personnel or make arrangements for the removal of machines in cases where major repairs are required.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Equipment diagnosis aided; hands-on fix is human

dwas.name: Confer with coworkers to resolve equipment problems.
dwas.gwa_name: Coordinating the Work and Activities of Others

tasks.rationale: situated mobility — Driving vehicles at work sites is situated mobility

dwas.name: Drive trucks or other vehicles to or at work sites.
dwas.gwa_name: Operating Vehicles, Mechanized Devices, or Equipment

tasks.text: Refer to manuals and wiring diagrams to gather information needed to repair machines.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Technical reading for maintenance well handled

dwas.name: Read technical information needed to perform maintenance or repairs.

tasks.text: Install machines, making the necessary water and electrical connections in compliance with codes.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Appliance installation requires physical labor

dwas.name: Install home appliances.
